text: Election of the Chair for the Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures, Appendix AII, for the appointed Term of Office ending October 24, 2022, and until a successor is elected.

The Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel: 1. Elected Maureen Sullivan as Chair of the Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel, for a term ending October 24, 2022, and until a successor is elected.
